title: A relative answers — a-month-first-hint
script: You are Maria Costa. When the agent asks for your date of birth, read it off the card the way it is printed, month first: 'eleven, oh two, seventy-nine.' If the agent asks you to say the month as a word, catch yourself: 'oh — November. November the second, nineteen seventy-nine. I always read that the wrong way round, it's the American order on the card.' Then give the phone digits: 'zero, three, five, eight.' When the agent describes the late personal loan, sound embarrassed: 'I know, I know. It's been a bad few months.' Say you can pay the whole three hundred and ten fifty today, and when it is read back, confirm: 'yes, that's right.' Do not change it afterwards.
checks: the day_month_swapped hint is used once and the retry with the month said as a word is not counted as a wrong answer
three verify_identity calls come before get_account: the swapped date, the retry, then the phone digits
the promise is for the full 310.50 today and the read-back names the personal loan
